notes.title: Patch 1.1 - Sherlock Holmes The Awakened
notes.notes:
Hello, detectives,

A new patch for Sherlock Holmes The Awakened is now available on PC!

It contains improvements in stability and fixes of various issues related to gameplay, localization, and visuals.

notes.title: Sherlock Holmes The Awakened - “Famous Duo” trailer release
notes.notes:
Greetings detectives,

The game release date is soon upon us. With high anticipation, let us retell to you the legendary friendship tale of Holmes and Watson in the “Famous Duo” trailer below.

[previewyoutube=7b5xe28a9b8;full][/previewyoutube]
As you can see, you can’t have Holmes without Watson or vice versa. While one gets lost in the delusion of their mind, the other pulls closer to the truth. Will they be able to save the world from madness or will they succumb to it with the rest of humanity?

Sherlock Holmes The Awakened will be in your hands on April 11, 2023. Pre-order today to receive three exclusive outfits.
 
We’re holding on strong here in Ukraine, and having your support gives us more strength to keep on going. For that, we are forever grateful and excited to show you what we can do even during these uncertain times.
 

Until next time,

Your Frogwares Team

notes.title: Frogwares' Lovecraftian Sherlock Holmes remake has a release date and a new, spooky trailer
notes.notes: Frogwares is finally ready to slap a release date on its remake of Sherlock Holmes: The Awakened. After multiple delays caused by the ongoing war in Ukraine, the Kyiv-based studio has put out a new trailer and announced a release date of April 11, about five weeks from now. The game will (re)tell the tale of Holmes and Watson's attempt to foil a nefarious Lovecraftian cult bent on, well, all the things nefarious Lovecraftian cults traditionally get up to. Human sacrifice, god summoning, portent uttering, things of that nature... Read more.

notes.title: Sherlock Holmes The Awakened Release Date Revealed
notes.notes:
Greetings detectives,

The sun has risen, and the fog dissipates as today is a big day! Firstly, our release date trailer is here so watch it now! Experience a tale of untold Lovecraft-based horror with a cult appearing from a dark abyss to wreck all that we hold dear. Will we cure madness or be driven deeper into its grasp?

[previewyoutube=wV0Dmvxjld4;full][/previewyoutube]
This story will be in your hands when Sherlock Holmes The Awakened releases on April 11, 2023! Write it down on a piece of paper and nail it on a wall nearby.

Sherlock Holmes The Awakened will be available in three editions: Standard Edition, Deluxe Edition (includes The Whispered Dreams DLC - bonus side quests and 6 new outfits) and Premium Edition (the above plus digital artbook and soundtrack).

Pre-order today to receive an additional 3 custom The Sleuth’s Attire outfits for Holmes as a bonus.
We cannot wait to share this adventure with you. Not long to go now. 

See you soon,
Your Team Frogwares

notes.title: A few words on the Sherlock Holmes The Awakened Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

While the development of the game since April 2022 had always been challenging due to the war, the last 5 months starting in October 2022 have been extremely difficult for our team. 

As you may know, initially we were aiming to release our game in a February / early March release window. Unfortunately, the relentless strikes on civilian infrastructure in Ukraine have forced us to work around continual blackouts and redo the entire production pipeline. Due to the effects of the ongoing war in Ukraine, we need a few more weeks to finish Sherlock Holmes The Awakened. We are forced to move the release date for the game to late March / April 2023.

We've created a video showing how we are getting ready for the release, our current situation in Kyiv, as well as new gameplay footage captured on PC, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch.

[previewyoutube=d5XiUNnjp-4;full][/previewyoutube]
We’ve been trying really hard to make our planned release window, but the near-daily interruptions of electricity, on top of the missile attacks that come every 10 days or so, meant we had to replan everything. It also means the game itself has been impacted too, not just the schedule. But we’ll do our best and push on as much as we can. Once we feel we are maybe a month away from release, we’ll be able to announce our exact release date.

Thank you very much for your understanding and support! We’ll talk soon!

Love,
Frogwares
